g.text: Same model, same NVIDIA A40: what a serving path changes
The research path pays ~120 µs per prompt token in unfused kernels and per-request Python; vLLM brings that to ~48 µs and halves the fixed floor, so the option list stops dominating.
Jev's line is its API round trip as observed by our client, network included.
